  • Ballots Sent = Ballots mailed, walk-in voters and MIL
  • Ballots Received = Voted Ballots returned to the auditor (this number includes received Walk-In ballots)
  • Walk-In Voters = Voters who come to the auditor's office to request a ballot that they vote or take home and return at the auditor’s office
  • MIL = Military and Overseas Citizens ballots sent
